page_title: SRB 2-3 SWI | Serbia v Switzerland 02/12/2022, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+11' The match has just finished.
90+11' A rebound spins to Nemanja Radonjic (Serbia) inside the box, but his sliced shot flies just wide of the right post.
90+10' The free kick is taken by Filip Kostic (Serbia), but ball is cleared.
90+9' Fabian Schar (Switzerland) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Fernando Rapallini didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
90+8' Fernando Rapallini blows his whistle. Nikola Milenkovic (Serbia) commits a foul after dangerous play.
90+6' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Noah Okafor (Switzerland) is coming onto the pitch as Breel Embolo cannot continue after picking up an injury.
90+5' Nikola Milenkovic (Serbia) is yellow-carded for breaking the rules of the game.
90+5' Granit Xhaka (Switzerland) gets a yellow card.
90+3' A cross is slung in towards the penalty spot and Luka Jovic (Serbia) creates space for himself but sends his header inches over the bar.

90+1' Edimilson Fernandes (Switzerland) latches on to a precise pass and finds himself one-on-one with the keeper, but his effort is straight at Vanja Milinkovic-Savic, who is alert and makes an easy save to deny him.
90' 7 additional min. will be played.
89' Sasa Lukic (Serbia) brings an opponent down and Fernando Rapallini interrupts the game.
87' The attendance for today's match is 41378.
83' Here's the change. Ruben Vargas leaves the pitch and Christian Fassnacht (Switzerland) comes on as a substitute.
83' Filip Djuricic (Serbia) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
83' Manuel Akanji (Switzerland) receives the ball from the resulting free kick and unleashes a strike from the edge of the box, but his effort goes narrowly wide of the right post!
82' Aleksandar Mitrovic (Serbia) uses bad language while talking to the referee and receives a yellow card for dissent.
82' Nemanja Gudelj (Serbia) will miss the next game.
81' A yellow card for a tackle by Nemanja Gudelj (Serbia). Fernando Rapallini doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
81' Filip Djuricic (Serbia) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
80' Sasa Lukic (Serbia) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Fernando Rapallini no option but to blow his whistle.
79' The game is interrupted. Strahinja Pavlovic (Serbia) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
78' Dragan Stojkovic decides to make a substitution. Andrija Zivkovic will be replaced by Nemanja Radonjic (Serbia).
78' Substitution. Filip Djuricic (Serbia) has come on for Dusan Tadic.
77' Luka Jovic (Serbia) commits a rough challenge and Fernando Rapallini blows his whistle for a foul.
74' Nemanja Gudelj (Serbia) makes a rough challenge and Fernando Rapallini blows his whistle for a foul.
72' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Aleksandar Mitrovic (Serbia) inside the box following a slide rule pass.
71' Aleksandar Mitrovic (Serbia) launches into a thunderous tackle on his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
70' Filip Kostic (Serbia) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
69' Murat Yakin has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Denis Zakaria (Switzerland) replacing Xherdan Shaqiri.
69' Murat Yakin has decided to substitute Djibril Sow and he is replaced by Edimilson Fernandes (Switzerland).
68' It is time for a substitution. Nemanja Maksimovic (Serbia) is on for Sergej Milinkovic-Savic.
66' Although Predrag Rajkovic (Serbia) is just on the bench, Fernando Rapallini has awarded him with a yellow card. Unsporting behavior says the referee.
65' Aleksandar Mitrovic (Serbia) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
64' Half-chance! Filip Kostic (Serbia) plays a pass into the box, but Gregor Kobel reacts well to snuff out the attack.
62' Filip Kostic (Serbia) jumps into a tackle and Fernando Rapallini signals a foul.
61' A pass across the box picks out an unmarked Dusan Tadic (Serbia) and he tries to place the ball towards the roof of the net, but it goes just over the bar.
59' Sergej Milinkovic-Savic (Serbia) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Fernando Rapallini blows for a foul.
58' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Filip Kostic (Serbia) but poses no threat.
57' Breel Embolo (Switzerland) is left with the simplest of tasks from close in after a lucky rebound off one of his own teammates, but somehow he skies his shot high over the bar.
57' Fabian Schar (Switzerland) receives a sweet pass inside the box, but his effort on goal is blocked by the defender.
56' Strahinja Pavlovic (Serbia) will miss the next game because of that yellow card.
56' Strahinja Pavlovic (Serbia) has tested the patience of referee Fernando Rapallini and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
55' Dragan Stojkovic prepares a substitution. Dusan Vlahovic is replaced by Luka Jovic (Serbia).
55' Substitution. Milos Veljkovic makes his way off the pitch and Nemanja Gudelj (Serbia) comes on as his replacement.
54' Granit Xhaka (Switzerland) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Fernando Rapallini signals.
53' Breel Embolo (Switzerland) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.

48' 2 - 3 Goal! Ruben Vargas displays great vision and sends a pass to Remo Freuler (Switzerland), who shows brilliant composure inside the box to bury the ball from close range in the back of the net. The score is 2:3.
47' Sergej Milinkovic-Savic (Serbia) sees a yellow card from Fernando Rapallini after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
47' Sasa Lukic (Serbia) gets booked for the first time in this match.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+2' A pass by Xherdan Shaqiri (Switzerland) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
45+1' Manuel Akanji (Switzerland) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
45' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
44' 2 - 2 Goal! Silvan Widmer puts the ball on a plate for Breel Embolo (Switzerland), who scores with a simple close-range finish. It's 2:2.
44' Ricardo Rodriguez (Switzerland) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
41' Ricardo Rodriguez (Switzerland) sends a cross into the box, but Vanja Milinkovic-Savic comes off his line to gather the ball.
39' Granit Xhaka (Switzerland) was too forceful with his tackle and Fernando Rapallini interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
38' The defence had a hard time blocking out the strike from Ruben Vargas (Switzerland). He didn't hesitate and finished from outside the box right after he had received a pass from his teammate.
35' 2 - 1 Goal! Dusan Vlahovic (Serbia) pounced on a loose ball inside the penalty area and beats the goalkeeper with a shot into the bottom right corner. He makes it 2:1.
34' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Ruben Vargas (Switzerland) was quite harsh and Fernando Rapallini didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
33' Andrija Zivkovic (Serbia) clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of Aleksandar Mitrovic, but he can't get on the end of the pass.
31' Xherdan Shaqiri (Switzerland) threw away a promising scoring opportunity. He received a fine cross inside the 6-yard box, but his shot missed the target close to the right post.
30' Dusan Tadic (Serbia) brings down his opponent with a very late tackle.
26' 1 - 1 Goal! A nice lofted pass into the box by Dusan Tadic is pounced on by Aleksandar Mitrovic (Serbia). His close-range header flashes past Gregor Kobel and into the right of the goal. 1:1.
26' Fernando Rapallini couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Milos Veljkovic (Serbia) and blew his whistle.
25' Dusan Tadic (Serbia) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.

23' Dusan Vlahovic (Serbia) attempts to convert a cross into a goal, but his promising header from near the penalty spot towards the middle of the net is denied by Gregor Kobel. This effort really didn't trouble him.
22' The keeper makes a simple save after Granit Xhaka (Switzerland) received a short pass and shot low from the edge of the box towards the middle of the goal.
20' 0 - 1 Goal! Djibril Sow plays it to Xherdan Shaqiri (Switzerland), whose deflected shot from inside the box goes past the helpless Vanja Milinkovic-Savic. 0:1.
19' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Filip Kostic (Serbia).
18' Filip Kostic (Serbia) tries to send a low pass into the box, but it's blocked and cleared.
17' Dusan Tadic (Serbia) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.
17' Strahinja Pavlovic (Serbia) sends a sweet pass into the penalty area, but one of the defenders averts the danger. The ball goes out of play. Serbia are awarded a corner kick.
16' Dusan Tadic (Serbia) delivers a poor cross from a free kick as one of the defenders comfortably clears it away.
15' Fernando Rapallini shows a yellow card to Silvan Widmer (Switzerland) for a tough tackle.
14' Granit Xhaka (Switzerland) gets on the end of a pass and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players.
13' Sasa Lukic (Serbia) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Fernando Rapallini blows his whistle for a foul.

11' OFF THE POST! Andrija Zivkovic (Serbia) runs towards the goal to give his teammate support. He receives a fantastic pass and shoots from the edge of the box, but it crashes against the left post. It could have been a brilliant goal, unlucky.
10' Dusan Tadic (Serbia) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
7' Ruben Vargas (Switzerland) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Vanja Milinkovic-Savic intercepts the ball.
6' Nikola Milenkovic (Serbia) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Fernando Rapallini has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
5' Nikola Milenkovic (Serbia) rises high to meet a cross from the corner kick and plants a header from inside the penalty area. His effort went just narrowly wide of the left post.
5' Dusan Tadic (Serbia) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.
4' A cross from Filip Kostic (Serbia) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
2' Granit Xhaka (Switzerland) hits a piledriver from the edge of the box, but Vanja Milinkovic-Savic acrobatically dives to stop the effort. Superb save!
1' Breel Embolo (Switzerland) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot towards the middle of the goal was easily saved by Vanja Milinkovic-Savic.
1' The match has just started.
The players are out at last! Switzerland will take the kick-off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Fernando Rapallini.
